Full 2026 regular season

The binary winner study uses the last public price available to the model one hour before kickoff as scheduled at the time. The table shows its actual lead when the announced start changed. Brier is omitted for ties. Completed game rows show the N106 same-origin forecasts where the sport and market records match. The evidence column identifies earlier releases on uncovered games. Confirmed future rows pair N106 win probabilities with the latest source-qualified point forecasts. Original counts cover the N101 recovery study.

Score pairs are away–home. The margin comparison uses HistGB at T−60 when its origin matches. Each model uses prices available at its own decision time. Rows outside this cohort retain the preceding release and identify its comparison timing. Confirmed future win probabilities include a separate tie outcome. Blank fields indicate unavailable or inapplicable evidence.
